title: Make Refuse-held checkpoint retry tests independent of scripted authority queue exhaustion
outcome: The refusal-held retry witnesses expose an erroneous retry while preserving the original canonical refusal, request and settlement invariants; authority queue exhaustion cannot be the only reason no checkpoint is sent.
acceptance: The carried-check refusal test explicitly establishes the original work-authority image before its retry ticks, and documents any other eligibility gate that can mask the negative witness.
The source-observation refusal test's existing queued binding consumption is established before changing it; optional hardening preserves all original negative assertions.
Focused checks covering changed witnesses pass without product changes, timeout inflation, skipped tests or weakened assertions.
